# AFT listing pages (excerpts, 2023)

Trimmed excerpts of judgment listing pages saved from the live Armed Forces Tribunal bench sites in
2023, taken from the MIT-licensed repository github.com/L-Bellingcat/army-tribunals (`web_pages/`).
They are public pages of official sites, cut down to a few rows so the tests exercise the real
markup. They show the 2023 layout; the sites may have changed since.
